summary:
# MARS – Mars Exploration and Colony Simulation

As the NOVA-3 team, we developed an exploration and colony-building application called MARS. Our project aims to introduce the resources and technologies needed to make Mars suitable for human life in the future through an enjoyable and interactive experience.

In our application, users explore the real world by walking with the help of GPS technology, collect materials, and use these resources to build their own Mars colonies. They can construct habitats, greenhouses, energy systems, and research centers. When determining the uses of these resources, we make use of NASA's scientific data and the geological characteristics of Mars.

Instead of limiting space exploration to theoretical knowledge, our project makes learning more engaging through gamification. It also encourages users to stay active and explore their surroundings. With MARS, we aim to combine science with the real world and increase interest in space exploration.
details:
PROJECT DETAILS – MARS

MARS is an exploration and colony simulation project that teaches users about the exploration of Mars and how future colonies could be established through gamification.

The main operating system of our application is based on GPS technology. Users explore the real world by walking and collect virtual materials they encounter through the application. The collected resources are added to the player's inventory. Users can use these resources to build their own Mars colonies and construct habitats, greenhouses, energy systems, and research centers. In this way, exploration and building mechanics are connected.

One of the most important benefits of our project is that it teaches space and astronomy not only through theoretical information but also through an interactive experience. At the same time, it encourages users to walk, explore their surroundings, and develop an interest in scientific research.

During the development process, we made use of web-based application development tools, GPS and mapping systems, interface design, and data management technologies. We also benefited from the software tools provided by the development platform we used to create our project.

In terms of creativity, the most unique aspect of MARS is that it combines real-world walking experiences with Mars exploration. The ability of users to build colonies using the resources they collect and connect them with scientific information about Mars makes our project different from an ordinary educational application.

While developing our project, we considered factors such as scientific accuracy, user experience, accessibility, entertainment, and sustainability. We used NASA's scientific data about Mars and the planet's geological characteristics to determine the possible uses of different resources.

Our goal is to make space exploration more enjoyable and accessible while teaching people about the challenges and requirements of establishing human life on Mars through an interactive experience.
